text:
mia: quick UX/a11y pass on the export preview panel in the batch embeddings flow. noticed 3 issues: keyboard order flips between preview collapsed/expanded, SR reads huge JSON blob when preview auto-expands, and file name shown is just "vectors.csv" which is ambiguous for customers exporting many sets. attaching a short screen recording.

sam: saw this too. when preview auto-expands the keyboard focus jumps into the preview content and you can't easily hit the confirm CTA without tabbing a lot. feels like a keyboard trap.

anita: accessibility notes:
- never auto-focus into large, scrollable previews. focus should stay on the dialog or the CTA group.
- hide heavy DOM (the full preview table) from AT via aria-hidden until expanded by user.
- expose a concise summary in aria-describedby: e.g. "Preview collapsed: 12 rows, 153KB estimated. Press Enter to expand."
- keyboard order: logical order should be heading -> summary -> primary CTA -> secondary actions -> preview toggle -> preview content.

kai: copy + microcopy: suggested changes:
- file name: default to `vectors-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.csv` (or `vectors-<collection>-YYYYMMDD.csv` if collection name available) so users can differentiate downloads.
- CTA text: `Start export (background)` feels clunky. prefer `Start export` and smaller explanatory subtext: `Runs in background. We'll notify you.`
- preview toggle: instead of `Show preview` use `Show export preview (12 rows, ~153KB)` to set expectations.

olivia: product constraints and telemetry:
- we need to show estimated size + an option to limit rows (checkbox "Export all rows" unchecked by default with quick selector for first 100/1k/all). Large exports cost money and take time.
- add analytics events: `export_preview_toggled` (expanded/collapsed, count, estimated_size), `export_started` (format, count, limit_applied, notify_opt_in).
-ci-bot: integration tests: export-preview toggles added to e2e at PR 11fa3b. please verify keyboard scenarios.

mia: actionable summary:
- force focus to dialog heading on open; keep focus on CTA group (dev)
- mark preview DOM aria-hidden until explicit expand (dev + a11y)
- change file naming pattern to include date/collection when available (product + eng)
- update CTA copy to `Start export` + subtext `Runs in background. You will be notified.` (design)
- preview toggle label to include row count + est size (design)
- add `Export first N rows` quick selector in modal (product)
- add analytics events above (eng)

Can folks +1 and I'll create the design ticket with screenshots and updated Figma frames?

sam: +1. I'll own the e2e keyboard tests.
anita: +1, I'll add the checklist for the a11y ticket (aria-hidden, focus management, proper labels).
kai: +1 on file naming and preview label, will drop copy variants in Figma.
olivia: +1, filing a product ticket for row limit + retention messaging.
ci-bot: staging: export-preview-fixes deployed to staging at commit a8d5c4. smoke tests queued. :white_check_mark:
